svg.title: SOME/IP #84 — complete workflow
svg.desc: All 99 native nodes and 106 distinct connections; parallel success and failure transitions to the same next node are combined. Follow arrows down column 1, up column 2, and continue across. Conditional repairs appear after their checks; success may bypass them.
svg.text: 99 nodes · 38 agent drafts + 4 conditional repairs + 54 deterministic checks + start / human review / exit
Agents: DeepSeek Flash (high reasoning) · One complete pass · Human engineering acceptance remains pending
Follow the arrows across five folded columns. Red dashed arrows mark repair and retry routes. Hover for exact native references.
Measurements retain failures, unavailable tools and unknown applicability. Successful collection does not imply engineering acceptance.
